params.body:
## What

`<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">` in two layouts:

- `layouts/guest`: login, forgotten and new password, both second-factor screens, and the invitation screens.
- `layouts/app`: everything behind the login.

Left alone on purpose:

- `layouts/website`. The dealer's website module is indexed by design: it runs as an iframe on the dealer's own site, and `public/robots.txt` explains why closing it would take the dealer's cars out of Google.
- `public/robots.txt` itself. It keeps disallowing `/showroom/` only. A crawler that is blocked never reads a noindex.

## Why

Elixir scores basic tags on the pages it can reach from outside. On traders.stocklistdealer.eu that is the login screen, so the project carried an SEO task at 50/100 for a page nobody should find. Since abovebeyond-ai/elixir#251, Elixir leaves noindex pages out of the basic-tags score, so this ends the task at the source.

## Tests

New test `SignInIsNotIndexedTest`: `/login` carries the meta tag.
params.title: Mark the sign-in and the app noindex, leave the website module indexed
